Live, 2026-10-20, tick qa-audit-dogfood-2026-10-20-11-29-14 (battery coding-hermes-boardctl @ 676985019ff27074d5a6ed23660ea35f3de748e7, agent 3d7287b1 on bunker-mvp, launched 11:35:50Z, CELLS-DONE 11:41:00Z, collect COLLECTED rows=19 rc=0 in 91.01s; evidence /tmp/qa-audit-df-20261020-1129/boardctl-evidence.jsonl, harvest /tmp/qa-audit-df-20261020-1129/harvest/qa-logs-1456601).
Cell text observed: ci-pass OK "act: 1 jobs green — rc=0 (1 triggerable workflow(s))".
(1) The count is computed from a dead alternation. Measured on the battery's own ci.log: `grep -cE 'Job succeeded|✅ Success' ci.log` = 1 and `grep -c '✅ Success' ci.log` = 0, although the log holds 15 lines of the form '✅  Success - Main <step>' (act separates the glyph from the word with TWO spaces, the pattern uses ONE) and 1 '🏁  Job succeeded' line. So the useful alternative never fires and the number silently degenerates to a 'Job succeeded' line count — it cannot report step-level success at all.
(2) Nothing in the row says whether the workflow ran tests. This repo's workflow does ('✅  Success - Main Test [22.599040296s]'), but the identical cell text is produced for a lint-only workflow, so an operator reading the battery verdict cannot tell 'repo suite green' from 'no test step exists'.
(3) On the act-green path the harness runs NO native suite: the harvested per-cell log set contains 14 files (buildx, ci, compose, disc, ep-build, ep, inst, node, qa-head, res, toolchain, up1, up2, zig) and NO native.log — the native leg exists only in the act-red branch (bunker-qa.sh:2053), so ci-pass OK here carries act-only evidence.
The only native evidence in this battery came from the chaos-resource cell (res.log: 12 packages ok under the 3G cap, github.com/coding-hermes/boardctl/... all ok).
FIX DIRECTION: (a) fix the pattern so it matches act's real output (tolerate multiple spaces / drop the glyph, and count steps and jobs separately); (b) put a tests-ran marker in the cell text — e.g. the act job's step names, or a flag set when a step command matched a test-like invocation — so ci-pass OK can never be read as a green suite on a workflow that has no test step.
ACCEPTANCE: a battery on a repo whose workflow HAS a test step names that step in the ci-pass cell text; a battery on a workflow WITHOUT a test step does not read as a green suite (explicit 'no test step' note); the step/job counts in the cell match the act log line counts on the same run; a regression render test asserts the pattern matches a captured '✅  Success - Main X' sample.
reasoning:
Mechanism read from source (working tree sha256 56294ccdff0b19473f10e6f0189dc0ec2fd2cd36e7b720ea9bf89b94c6ce39a4): bunker-qa.sh:2040 `if [ "$ci_rc" = "0" ]` -> :2041 `cell ci-pass OK "act: $(grep -cE 'Job succeeded|✅ Success' $LOGD/ci.log ...) jobs green — rc=0 ..."`; the native run lives only in the else (act-red) branch at :2053. Design comment at :1801 states the native suite is the authoritative FALLBACK, which is why the skip exists — the defect is not the skip but that the OK row is evidence-free about tests and its counting alternative is dead.
DEDUPE: DG-006 covers the same root cause for a DIFFERENT cell (chaos-disconnect's $native_cmd is undefined on the act-green path); QA-ASCE-VACUOUS-001 covers the act-RED native runner collecting zero tests; DG-001 covers cross-cell composition (ci-pass OK over a fresh-install FAIL). None of them grades the ci-pass cell text/count itself, so this is filed as its own row and cites DG-006 in foreman_note as the related mechanism.
foreman_note: Related mechanism, different cell: DG-006 (native_cmd undefined on the act-green path -> chaos-disconnect always UNVERIFIED). Fixing this row's counting + tests-ran marker removes the same blind spot from the ci-pass row; neither fix subsumes the other. Filed by the qa-audit dogfood lane from a real battery run, not from a test suite.
acceptance_criteria: PASS: the ci-pass count pattern matches act's real step lines — on a log holding 'Success - Main Test' with act's two-space separator the shipped pattern prints a count of at least 1 via `grep -cE`, so the count no longer degenerates to job-success lines and can report step-level success.

title: P4 — `bunker-qa.sh launch --help` (the universal way to ask a CLI for usage) is graded as a repo path: no usage handling anywhere in launch()/run(), and the refusal path writes an evidence .meta whose project= field is basename's own help text
detail:
Live, 2026-10-20, tick qa-audit-dogfood-2026-10-20-11-29-14. A launch invoked with the flag `--help` produced:
  evidence /tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261020T113445Z-1848342.jsonl -> row: {"cell":"run_battery","status":"FAIL","detail":"launch refused: --help is not a git repo (git resolves toplevel: none) — a role-lane workdir was dispatched instead of the primary repo; re-dispatch against the real workdir"} (rc=1, no agent spawned — the fail-closed behaviour itself is correct).
  meta /tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261020T113445Z-1848342.jsonl.meta -> the project= field carries EIGHT lines of basename(1)'s own usage text ("Print NAME with any leading directory components removed ... Usage: basename [-z] NAME [SUFFIX] ...").
MECHANISM: launch() takes the target from ${1:?usage: ...} with no flag interception (bunker-qa.sh:3035-3037) and derives PROJ=$(basename "$repo") (:3041); basename consumes `--help` as ITS own option and prints its help to stdout, so PROJ becomes multi-line help text, which write_meta stores verbatim.
IMPACT: two, both small but real — (a) a user cannot discover the CLI surface with -h/--help even though the file carries a Usage block, so the first-touch path is 'guess and get refused'; (b) every such probe leaves a timestamped evidence file plus a .meta whose project= field is junk, so a /tmp evidence sweep cannot tell a help probe from a genuine mis-dispatched workdir refusal.
FIX DIRECTION: intercept -h/--help/usage (and any target starting with '-') at the top of launch() and run() and print the Usage block (§Usage) before the repo sanity check; skip write_meta on the help path; treat a flag-shaped target as an argument error rather than a repo-path refusal.
ACCEPTANCE: `bunker-qa.sh launch --help` prints the Usage block and exits non-zero WITHOUT writing an evidence jsonl or .meta; a repo-path refusal still writes its row and a single-line project= value; a regression test asserts no multi-line project= field.
reasoning:
Observed by the dogfood run's own first-touch probe (a user asking the CLI for help) and reconstructed from source at bunker-qa.sh:3035-3041 (launch) with the twin at :2889/:2913 (run, subdirectory branch).
DEDUPE: DOC-003 ('Usage block documents --server/--ttl flags that run/launch do not [support]') is the adjacent doc-rot row — different defect (doc names unsupported flags) and different fix (edit the doc). This row is about argument handling and the garbage meta the refusal path writes. DOC-002/DOC-004 are unrelated doc-accuracy rows. Nothing on the board covers --help handling.
foreman_note: Cheap fix (one guard at the top of launch()/run() + skip write_meta on the help path). Priority kept at P4 because nothing is blocked by it, but it is the first thing a new user does with an unknown CLI. Related: DOC-003 (same Usage block, doc-rot angle).

title: P1 — the docker-unavailable fail-closed gate `exit 2`s the generated battery BEFORE ci-pass/ui-probe/upgrade, so a docker-less agent grades a repo with NO build/test/CI/UI evidence and the run still reports complete
detail:
Live, 2026-10-22/23 (four batteries): mafia-ai-benchmark 18:38Z (/tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261022T183828Z-894965.jsonl), hermes-rs 02:11Z (/tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261023T021128Z-3743645.jsonl), coding-hermes-tools 02:31Z (/tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261023T023152Z-70667.jsonl), guard 02:36Z (/tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261023T023633Z-172914.jsonl). Every one has exactly 16 evidence rows: repo-head + toolchain-bootstrap + fresh-install OK, then 5 docker/chaos cells SKIPPED, then NOTHING — no ci-pass, no ui-probe, no upgrade, no chaos-disconnect.
MECHANISM: the generated qa-run.sh gates all docker legs on one probe (bunker-qa.sh:1964-1965, `QA_DOCKER_OK`). On failure the block (bunker-qa.sh:1966-1977) emits the 5 SKIPPED cells, then `echo CELLS-DONE`, `touch ~/qa-run.finished`, `exit 2`. Both the ci-pass staging (.github/workflows -> ~/qa-act-wf, :2022) and ci-pass itself (:2036), ui-probe (:2316) and upgrade all sit AFTER that early exit, so they never execute. The block's own header comment (:1958-1963) states the intent was to grade the docker legs SKIPPED so the rest of the battery continues — the implementation truncates instead, i.e. QA-CONSENSUS-24's fix moved the truncation earlier (it used to abort after the upgrade cell) rather than removing it.
CONTRAST (same script, docker available): the 12:31Z run (/tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261022T123144Z-956078.jsonl) emitted ci-pass FAIL, ui-probe INFO, upgrade FAIL, chaos-* — i.e. the non-docker half of the battery exists and works when QA_DOCKER_OK=1.
IMPACT: (a) tonight's four targets got ZERO build/test/CI/UI signal while the driver printed 'QA pass complete' and RC=0 — a false-green shape, not just a gap; (b) it corrupts the ledger: the 01:13Z tick rows for logsey-foreman and dexdat-memory-foreman claim cells_run=10, cells_passed=10 with no ci-pass ever emitted (qa-ledger.jsonl); the 18:38Z mafia event even lists a ci-pass 'UNVERIFIED' cell that does not exist in its evidence file. (c) any repo whose ONLY defect lives in its suite/CI is invisible on every docker-less agent.
TRIGGER (separate, infra): bunker-mvp agents have had no docker socket since ~18:38Z today (probe waits 40s, then QA_DOCKER_OK=0); that env outage is what exposes the truncation, but the truncation is the harness defect.
FIX DIRECTION: do not exit. Mark the docker-dependent legs SKIPPED and fall through to ci-pass/ui-probe/upgrade/chaos-disconnect; if a hard stop is wanted, move the gate to immediately before the first docker-dependent cell (docker-deploy, :2250) so the native legs already ran. Keep `touch ~/qa-run.finished` for collect, and keep rc semantics (docker-unavailable => SUCCESS-with-SKIPPED, not exit 2).
ACCEPTANCE: on a docker-less agent a Go repo emits ci-pass (native suite) + ui-probe + upgrade + chaos-disconnect rows in the same evidence file; docker-deploy/chaos-shutdown/chaos-corruption/chaos-resource/chaos-errorpath are SKIPPED with the QA-CONSENSUS-24 reason; the driver exits 0; a regression test asserts the generated script contains no early exit between the toolchain bootstrap and the ci-pass cell.
reasoning: Reproduced tonight on four independent targets and corroborated by one same-script run from 12:31Z that DID run the non-docker cells. Source-verified at bunker-qa.sh:1966-1977 (gate) vs :2036 (ci-pass) / :2316 (ui-probe). DEDUPE: DG-005/DG-009 own the collect-side truncation HEURISTIC (JSON dialect), QA-HARNESS-LEAK-002 owns the agent leak on collect's truncated branch — all three are about DETECTING/cleaning a truncated battery; none is about the battery aborting itself before its non-docker cells. DG-015 is the act-green diagnosability defect (dead '✅ Success' pattern) and is untouched by this fix path.
foreman_note: Fix is a small control-flow change in the generated script (delete the exit, keep the cells) + one regression assertion. P1 because it silently converts four batteries a night into zero-coverage false greens.

title: P1 — vitest green suite graded ci-pass FAIL 'ZERO tests ran': pytest_zero_collected's count regex [0-9]+ (passed|failed|error) cannot match vitest's 'Total: <n> tests passed across N packages' wording; and the vacuous branch (bunker-qa.sh:2069-2070) fires before the ci-act cell, so the act leg's verdict vanishes from the evidence JSONL on every run whose native suite trips the false-vacuity detector
reasoning: P1 harness grading defect, reproduced live 2026-10-23 (qa-audit-foreman tick qa-audit-foreman-2026-10-23-09-10-57, heading battery agent dce0ff2e @ bunker-mvp, target repo /home/kara/heading, battery HEAD 2c59fe22402fc7880771b95d51f5ce7f0f952e50). Evidence JSONL row 14: ci-pass FAIL 'vacuous pass: native runner exited 0 but ZERO tests ran (summary: Total: 1295 tests passed across 10 packages)'. The native suite is the OPPOSITE of vacuous - pnpm vitest ran 1295 tests across 10 packages and all passed; the log carries a full count-bearing summary. Mechanism: native_zero_tests gates on the go-line shape and falls through to pytest_zero_collected, whose count regex is '[0-9]+ (passed|failed|error)' - vitest writes the count and the verb apart ('1295 tests passed'), so no count match, and the function returns 0 (zero collected) on a green suite. Second sub-defect, same control-flow branch (bunker-qa.sh:2067-2085): because the false-vacuous branch fires, the run never reaches the OK/ci-act pair at 2082-2083, so no ci-act cell is emitted at all even though the act leg failed rc!=0 - the act leg's verdict is silently absent from the evidence JSONL on every run whose native suite trips the detector. Impact: a fully green 1295-test suite is graded FAIL, which files product rows on a healthy repo (heading was never QA'd before, so this would have been its first finding) and hides act-leg signal on every such run. Evidence: /tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261023T091927Z-2321324.jsonl (ci-pass row 14, ts 2026-10-23T09:26:02Z). Fix direction: (a) extend pytest_zero_collected's count regex to also accept '<n> tests passed' wording (any '[0-9]+ <word> passed/failed' ordering), or (b) add a pnpm/vitest-specific zero-test classifier before the pytest fallthrough; (c) emit a ci-act cell (or annotate the ci-pass detail with the act rc) on the vacuous/native-runner-missing branches so an act leg's verdict never vanishes from the JSONL. Not the same defect as QA-ASCE-VACUOUS-001 (that is the pre-fix 'rc=0 graded OK with zero tests' shape; this is the post-fix detector's false-positive shape on a NON-vacuous green suite) and not QA-HARNESS-VACUOUS-001 (byte-identical vitest-ship test assertion, a different file entirely). Reader: harness maintainers of bunker-qa.sh. ch:trace row=QA-HARNESS-VACUOUS-002 spec=none:target-has-no-traceability-doctrine wave=qa-audit-foreman-2026-10-23-09-10-57 test=/tmp/bunker-qa-evidence-20261023T091927Z-2321324.jsonl doc=none:live-battery-evidence witness=dce0ff2e bunker-mvp QA-HEAD=2c59fe22 verdict=none:harness-defect-filed commit=none:harness-defect-not-yet-fixed
foreman_note: Fix must address BOTH faces: the pytest count regex false-negative on vitest wording, AND the missing ci-act cell on the vacuous branch (the act leg's verdict is graded but never written).
acceptance_criteria: `grep -c 'tests passed' ~/.hermes/scripts/bunker-qa.sh` prints a count >= 1, so the zero-collected count regex accepts the vitest shape '1295 tests passed' that the row's live battery misgraded.
